release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.1 - Bug Fixes:
- Fixed media URL display issue (images and videos now show correctly)
- Removed Block User and Report User options from Search Users screen
- Fixed Start Chat functionality to properly navigate to chat
- Improved responsive design for media modal across all platforms
- Added version display at bottom of sidebar
- Fixed Invalid Chat ID error when starting chats
- Enhanced cross-platform compatibility
- Updated UI/UX improvements
